boundary: Conditional inference only: a valid Tminus1 conventional stock Firecloud pair does NOT guarantee execution, and Tminus1 pre-move normal endpoints (especially mine-risk cases) do NOT prove arrival. The model emits both a hypothetical Chunnel destination and a no-Chunnel normal endpoint BEFORE reading any T observation. All candidate game IDs are excluded from earlier V6, V9, V13 research and chosen using archival metadata only. Missing, owner or hull drift, duplicate eligible Firecloud sources and any post-T interruptions abstain. After-Host T matching does not isolate the Chunnel phase or rule out other movement and fuel operations. No production executor changes or N+1 VCR comparisons. Same public100 corpus is NOT a freshly collected independent dataset.

frozen_selection.protocol: 20 games x 3 adjacent windows, metadata only, exclude entire V6/V9/V13 game sets
